// Compact inventory controls keep building art at its native 32-pixel size.
function compactIconV64(kind){
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=32;const g=canvas.getContext('2d');
 const r=(x,y,w,h,c)=>{g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(x,y,w,h)},ink='#272535',pale='#d2ded6',gold='#e3ba77';
 if(kind==='craft'){
  r(10,17,3,10,ink);r(12,15,3,10,'#986b49');r(14,13,3,9,'#c79963');
  r(9,8,15,7,ink);r(10,9,12,4,pale);r(18,12,5,4,'#899ba8');r(10,9,9,1,'#f0e9d3');
 }else if(kind==='info'){
  r(12,6,8,2,ink);r(10,8,12,10,ink);r(11,9,10,7,gold);r(13,7,6,11,gold);
  r(13,9,3,5,'#fff0be');r(14,17,4,4,'#a88a5f');r(13,21,6,2,pale);r(14,24,4,2,'#899ba8');
 }else if(kind==='wood'){
  r(8,12,17,11,ink);r(10,10,12,3,ink);r(9,13,15,8,'#94603f');r(11,11,10,3,'#d7a45a');
  r(10,14,2,6,'#e3ba77');r(14,14,1,6,'#54382e');r(19,13,2,8,'#54382e');r(21,14,2,5,'#c79963');
 }else if(kind==='ironIngot'||kind==='copperIngot'){
  r(8,14,17,8,ink);r(11,11,12,4,ink);r(10,15,13,5,kind==='ironIngot'?'#9facb9':'#d29668');
  r(12,12,9,3,kind==='ironIngot'?pale:'#f2c391');r(10,15,12,1,kind==='ironIngot'?pale:'#f2c391');
 }else{
  r(10,10,12,3,ink);r(7,13,18,8,ink);r(10,21,13,3,ink);
  r(11,11,10,3,kind==='dirt'?'#bd8c58':'#a1a6ac');r(9,14,14,6,kind==='dirt'?'#98633a':'#777f89');
  r(11,20,10,2,kind==='dirt'?'#81502e':'#626a74');r(11,14,4,2,kind==='dirt'?'#d1a66c':'#bbc2c4');
 }
 return canvas.toDataURL();
}
const compactArtV64={craft:compactIconV64('craft'),info:compactIconV64('info')};
const structureDetailsV64={
 storehouse:'Store up to 1,000 resources in one building inventory. Deposit resources, take them back, or pack the Storehouse to return its contents.',
 home:'Two adult beds, one baby slot and one kid slot. Assigned Workers return here at night. Children grow into new Workers.',
 workshop:'Craft buildings and ladders. A ladder batch uses five wood and makes ten ladders; a Worker buys a batch for one pocketed gold.',
 forge:'Smelt copper and iron ore into ingots. Manual crafting uses your inventory; automatic Worker crafting uses building inventory.',
 blacksmith:'Turn iron ingots into construction nails. Manual crafting uses your inventory; automatic Worker crafting uses building inventory.'
};
$('structuresTitle').textContent='Structures';
panelV48.querySelector('header small').hidden=true;
panelV48.querySelector('header + p').hidden=true;
resourcesV48.hidden=true;
panelV48.classList.add('compactStructuresV64');
for(const [type,d] of Object.entries(STRUCTURES_V46)){
 const card=$('structure-card-'+type),row=card.parentElement,craft=$('player-craft-'+type);
 card.querySelector('span').hidden=true;
 card.title=d.name+' · Drag to place';card.querySelector('img').alt='';
 row.setAttribute('role','group');row.setAttribute('aria-label',d.name);
 for(const cost of row.querySelectorAll('[data-material]'))cost.querySelector('img').src=compactIconV64(cost.dataset.material);
 const info=document.createElement('button');info.type='button';info.className='structureInfoV64';info.setAttribute('aria-label','More info about '+d.name);info.title=d.name+' · More info';
 const bulb=document.createElement('img');bulb.src=compactArtV64.info;bulb.alt='';info.append(bulb);
 const details=document.createElement('section');details.className='structureDetailsV64';details.id='structure-details-'+type;details.hidden=true;
 const heading=document.createElement('strong');heading.textContent=d.name;
 const text=document.createElement('p');text.textContent=structureDetailsV64[type]||d.note;
 const placement=document.createElement('p');placement.textContent='Drag the building icon onto a supported '+d.w+' × '+d.h+' foundation.';
 details.append(heading,text,placement);info.setAttribute('aria-controls',details.id);info.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
 info.onclick=()=>{
  const open=details.hidden;
  for(const button of panelV48.querySelectorAll('.structureInfoV64'))button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  for(const section of panelV48.querySelectorAll('.structureDetailsV64'))section.hidden=true;
  details.hidden=!open;info.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
  if(open)details.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
 };
 row.append(info,details);
 const hammer=document.createElement('img');hammer.src=compactArtV64.craft;hammer.alt='';craft._compactIconV64=hammer;
}
function refreshCompactStructuresV64(){
 for(const [type,d] of Object.entries(STRUCTURES_V46)){
  const button=$('player-craft-'+type),active=playerCraftV61?.type===type;
  button.replaceChildren(button._compactIconV64);
  button.setAttribute('aria-label',(active?'Crafting ':'Craft ')+d.name);
  button.setAttribute('aria-busy',String(active));button.classList.toggle('crafting',active);
 }
}
const compactRefreshBaseV64=refreshPlayerCraftV61;
refreshPlayerCraftV61=function(){compactRefreshBaseV64();refreshCompactStructuresV64()};
positionStructuresV48=function(){
 const anchor=triggerV48.getBoundingClientRect(),bar=$('bar').getBoundingClientRect(),width=Math.min(280,innerWidth-16);
 panelV48.style.left=Math.round(Math.max(8,Math.min(anchor.left,innerWidth-width-8)))+'px';
 panelV48.style.bottom=Math.round(innerHeight-bar.top+8)+'px';
 panelV48.style.maxHeight=Math.max(100,Math.floor(bar.top-16))+'px';
};
// Existing resize listeners hold the original function; finish with the compact anchor.
addEventListener('resize',positionStructuresV48);$('bar').addEventListener('scroll',positionStructuresV48,{passive:true});
refreshCompactStructuresV64();
